description: Implementation of ManufacturerService for managing manufacturer entities, including CRUD operations, listing by store and categories, and description management within a sales/merchandising application.

classes.name: ManufacturerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for manufacturer management, extending generic entity service and implementing manufacturer-specific operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a manufacturer by first retrieving it by ID and then performing the delete operation.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves list of manufacturers associated with a store, optionally filtered by language or categories.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a manufacturer, initializing descriptions set if null.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer or updates an existing one based on whether ID is present.
